mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at the decision time indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.10, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% indicates a weak labor market, which typically triggers monetary policy easing by the Federal Reserve, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction term in a regression of 20-day returns on HOUST and RSAFS is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during a late-cycle expansion phase signals a supply-side disruption that increases inflation expectations and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is above -0.05 in such regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) at the decision time indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 236 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 236, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is above -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above their respective moving averages signal robust economic expansion, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed their moving averages, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation, low-rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 236 and FEDFUNDS < 0.10), the Federal Reserve faces a policy dilemma that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 236 and FEDFUNDS < 0.10, or the Rank IC between the joint condition and 20-day returns is below -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
